mapper.select: SELECT id, voice_no, voice_type, title, content, company_id, vessel_id, reporter_user_id, reporter_anonymous, severity, status, assigned_to, resolved_at, resolution, email_sent_to, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_worker_voice WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT wv.id, wv.voice_no, wv.voice_type, wv.title, wv.content, wv.company_id, c.name AS company_name, wv.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, wv.reporter_user_id, ru.name AS reporter_name, wv.reporter_anonymous, wv.severity, wv.status, wv.assigned_to, au.name AS assignee_name, wv.resolved_at, wv.resolution, wv.email_sent_to, wv.created_at, wv.updated_at FROM tb_worker_voice wv LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = wv.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = wv.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.id = wv.reporter_user_id AND ru.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.id = wv.assigned_to AND au.deleted = 0 WHERE wv.id = #{id} AND wv.deleted = 0

SELECT wv.id, wv.voice_no, wv.voice_type, wv.title, wv.company_id, c.name AS company_name, wv.severity, wv.status, wv.reporter_anonymous, wv.created_at FROM tb_worker_voice wv LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = wv.company_id AND c.deleted = 0
ORDER BY wv.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_worker_voice ( voice_no, voice_type, title, content, company_id, vessel_id, reporter_user_id, reporter_anonymous, severity, status, assigned_to, resolved_at, resolution, email_sent_to, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{voiceNo}, #{voiceType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{companyId}, #{vesselId}, #{reporterUserId}, #{reporterAnonymous}0, #{severity}, #{status}'SUBMITTED', #{assignedTo}, #{resolvedAt}, #{resolution}, #{emailSentTo}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_worker_voice SET status = #{status}, assigned_to = COALESCE(#{assignedTo}, assigned_to), resolution = COALESCE(#{resolution}, resolution), resolved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') THEN SYSUTCDATETIME() ELSE resolved_at END, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_worker_voice SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(voice_no, 4) AS INT)), 0) FROM tb_worker_voice WHERE voice_no LIKE 'WV-' + #{dateStr} + '-%'
